tools.name: active
tools.description: Search active gTLD domains from a database of ~240 million registered domains, filtered by keyword, TLD, length, and character set. A market-analysis instrument for keyword distribution and saturation; results are registered domains, not available for registration. Related: expired, whois, dns.

params.name: tld
params.description: Filter by TLD (e.g., 'com', 'net', 'org'); when keyword is omitted, this is the browse target

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status — 'forsale' for domains listed for sale

params.name: keyword
params.description: Brand or industry term (min 2 chars). Omit to use TLD browse mode.

params.name: position
params.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'contain' (substring match).

tools.name: aged
tools.description: Search currently registered domains with 5-20+ years of history, filtered by keyword, TLD, age range, length, and sale status. These are live domains owned by someone, not free to register. Related: expired, whois, dns.

params.name: has_sale
params.description: Filter to domains listed for sale by their owner

tools.name: available
tools.description: Confirm a single domain's registrability and price. The definitive availability check for one domain. Related: bulk_available, whois, monitor.

tools.name: backlink_summary
tools.description: Return a domain's backlink profile: domain rank, total backlinks, referring domains, spam score, and link distribution. Related: whois, safety.

tools.name: bulk_available
tools.description: Return the upstream Availability service's point-in-time status for up to 10 domains. available is an affirmative registrability result; registered is already registered; expiring is in an expiry-related lifecycle and is not directly registrable; reserved is registry-reserved; unknown means no verification path produced a reliable conclusion. MCP does not infer availability from failures and removes affiliate fields from the upstream response.

params.name: domains
params.description: Comma-separated fully qualified domain names, maximum 10.

tools.name: bulk_tld
tools.description: Check registration status of one keyword across many TLDs at once, returning which TLDs are taken, available, or listed for sale. Related: tld_check, available.

tools.name: deleted
tools.description: Search domains that have completed the deletion cycle and are open for immediate registration at standard cost, filtered by keyword, TLD, age range, length, and character set. Related: available, bulk_available, whois.

params.name: hold
params.description: Registry hold status — no_hold = immediately registrable

tools.name: dns
tools.description: Resolve a domain's DNS records, including nameservers and hosting-related records. Related: whois, ns_reverse.

tools.name: domain_changes
tools.description: List registration and status changes to premium .com domains (short 1-4 letter and high-value single-word names) in the past 24 hours, filtered by change reason and length. Related: whois, ns_reverse.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Search by domain or keyword within the monitored pool

params.name: has_digit
params.description: false = letters only, true = contains digits, all = no filter

tools.name: expired
tools.description: Search domains in the deletion cycle: expired, in redemption, or pending delete. Still held by the current registrant, with time-sensitive acquisition windows. Filter by lifecycle status, TLD, age range, drop date, length, and character set. Related: monitor, deleted, whois.

params.name: status
params.description: expired = in registrar auction, redemption = owner can reclaim, pending_delete = drops in 1-5 days

tools.name: keyword_data
tools.description: Return search-volume, CPC, and competition data for a keyword. Related: keywords_trends.

tools.name: keywords_trends
tools.description: Return provider-computed keyword registration statistics. hot and emerging cover rolling keyword cohorts; prefix returns prefix activity buckets. scope=all represents the provider's filtered all-gTLD sample, while scope=com represents its pure-letter .com subset and is not available for prefix. Results are representative samples, not a complete registry feed, demand measurement, valuation, or investment recommendation.

params.name: scope
params.description: all = filtered all-gTLD sample; com = pure-letter .com subset. prefix supports all only.

tools.name: market
tools.description: Search currently registered domains that carry marketplace listing data, filtered by keyword, TLD, listing status, length, and character set. Results are live domains owned by someone. Related: keyword_data, tld_check.

params.name: tld
params.description: Filter by TLD (e.g., 'com', 'net', 'org'). Provide WITHOUT keyword to enter TLD browse mode (gTLDs only)

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status: 'forsale' for domains listed for sale

params.name: position
params.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'start'.

tools.name: market_price
tools.description: Return marketplace listing price and status (for_sale, make_offer, or not_found) for a domain. Related: available, aged.

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: Manage cross-platform domain monitoring tasks that track changes in WHOIS, DNS, and host-supplied page content. Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) in a private per-user directory. Actions: - get: retrieve monitors and check eligible WHOIS/DNS targets, returning current and previous data with change flags. - set: create a monitor, subject to the account tier's maximum. - update: save host-supplied page, WHOIS, or DNS state for a monitor. - delete: remove a monitor. Requires a registered acco

params.name: note
params.description: What to watch for — user's intent in natural language (set only)

params.name: page
params.description: Page content summary from web_fetch (update only)

params.name: tools
params.description: Comma-separated: whois, dns, web_fetch. Default: whois,dns (set only)

params.name: action
params.description: 'get', 'set', 'update', or 'delete'. Defaults to 'get' if not specified.

tools.name: nrds
tools.description: Search newly registered domains (last 60 days) by keyword across all TLDs, or browse a single gTLD without a keyword. Filter by recency, registration term, length, and character set. Related tools: whois, dns, ns_reverse, typosquat

params.name: has_sale
params.description: Filter to domains listed for sale

tools.name: ns_reverse
tools.description: Reverse NS lookup: find all gTLD domains hosted on a specific nameserver, filtered by TLD and keyword. Related: whois, dns.

tools.name: preferences
tools.description: Manage user preferences and memory settings. Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) in isolated per-user directories. Actions: - get: report whether memory is enabled and return saved preferences. - set: save preferences; memory_enabled must be true before any preferences, monitors, or strategies can be stored, and requires explicit user consent. - delete: permanently erase all stored user data (GDPR Article 17). Related: monitor, strategy.

params.name: action
params.description: 'get', 'set', or 'delete'. Defaults to 'get' if not specified.

params.name: memory_enabled
params.description: 'true' to enable memory, 'false' to disable. Must be enabled before using monitors or strategies. (set only)

tools.name: price
tools.description: Return standard registration and renewal price for a TLD. Related: available.

params.name: tld
params.description: TLD to query, comma-separated for multiple (e.g., 'com', 'com,io,ai')

tools.name: safety
tools.description: Return Google Safe Browsing status for a domain. Related: whois, backlink_summary.

tools.name: strategy
tools.description: Store user-authored strategy text, execution timestamps, and the most recent result in encrypted per-user storage. This tool does not provide presets, define opportunities, choose domains, or execute a workflow. Requires a registered account with memory enabled.

params.name: id
params.description: Saved strategy ID for update or delete.

params.name: action
params.description: get, set, update, or delete. Defaults to get.

params.name: result
params.description: Latest user- or host-supplied result summary for update.

params.name: strategy
params.description: User-authored text, maximum 500 characters, for set.

tools.name: tld_check
tools.description: Check how a prefix is registered across core TLDs, returning per-TLD status and aggregate counts. Related: bulk_tld, available.

tools.name: tld_rank
tools.description: Rank TLDs by registration volume and related metrics over a chosen period. Related: tld_trends.

params.name: type
params.description: Ranking type: 'newly' for today's new registrations, 'active' for total active domains

tools.name: tld_trends
tools.description: Return registration trend data for a TLD over time, or compare multiple TLDs, in active-total or newly-registered mode. Related: tld_rank, keywords_trends.

params.name: type
params.description: 'newly' for daily new registrations, 'active' for total active domains

params.name: action
params.description: 'data' for single TLD deep-dive, 'compare' for multi-TLD comparison

tools.name: typosquat
tools.description: Generate typosquat permutations for a domain and check which variants are registered. Produces omission, transposition, keyboard-adjacent replacement, insertion, repetition, hyphenation, vowel-swap, homoglyph, plural/singular, and TLD-swap variants. Each result includes the variant domain, mutation type, prefix TLD count (how many TLDs the prefix is registered under), and registration date if known. Use for brand protection, phishing detection, and defensive registration planning. Related tools:

tools.name: unregistered_ai
tools.description: Search unregistered short .ai domains by pattern (CVCV, CVCC, and other 3-4 letter shapes) that are still available for registration. Related: available, bulk_available.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Return the current account tier, per-tool-group usage, rate limits, and stateful Monitor and Strategy quotas.

tools.name: whois
tools.description: Return WHOIS/RDAP registration data for a domain: registrar, dates, status, and nameservers. Related: dns, safety.
